value.counterfactual: fossil Britain, like for like (s22): the actual system with net zero taken out; renewables' output replaced by extra running of existing fossil plant, then new CCGT/OCGT; merit-order uplift from Shao et al. 2022 (spec §15.5 item 1) in 2002-20, Jan-Apr 2021 and 2024-25p, and re-estimated on outturn with direct coefficients from May 2021 to Dec 2023 (0164, M9 B); extra running of the plant Britain had at the market price (0144 item 1A); gas-price feedback dQ / ((e_s + e_d) Q), e = 0.06 + 0.169 (Albrizio et al. 2022's pair, 0144 item 2A); 'mixed' closures by the margin test at the road's own coal load factor, kept coal paid its fixed cost less its margin, filter running cost in the price (0163 M2-M4); every coal station on its real permit hours, the 2011-14 LCPD opt-outs included and the kept LCPD stations held (0166, reading (i)); carbon in real Britain's price at the marginal plant from 1 Jan 2009 (0167, M7 merit order); half-hourly prices by Ofgem's month with Elexon MID's half-hour shape in both Britains from 12 Sep 2016 (0167, M8); the net-zero part of the generators' share of BSUoS and TNUoS taken out of fossil Britain's market price (0167, way 2); RO mutualisation payments received counted in the RO (0169); the five closures at their DUKES edition MW (C-009)

meta.label: Annex E (Version and change log): each change from v4-s37 to this release in build order, with its own measured effect on the 2002-24 headline, the sum of the measured steps, and any step still to measure

Annex D, VAT on the extra: by year, households' domestic share, the 5% rate, NZ11, GO7 and the VAT on the extra (NZ11 less GO7); NZ11 = 5% x (share x (NZ1 to NZ7) + NZ10), GO7 = 5% x share x (GO1 to GO5)
Annex D, the carbon split: by year, carbon in the wholesale price (NZ1c, inside NZ1, never added), of which carbon prices collected as tax on power (NZ1c_tax) and the rest (NZ1c_price)

Annex D, the 2001 levels and their netting: by year, the Fossil Fuel Levy (NZ2, to 2019) and EESoP (NZ10) netted at their 2001 levels with the VAT each carried, and the CCL netted at its 2001 rate (NZ8)
Annex D in full (0162 item 6): for each derived figure, the keys that give it and the keys that give its working

value.name: The gap, each year
value.equation: gap(y) = NZ(y) - RB(y); NZ(y) = NZ1 + NZ2 + NZ3 + NZ4 + NZ4b + NZ5 + NZ6 + NZ7 + NZ8 + NZ10 + NZ11 + S1; RB(y) = GO1 + GO1k + GO2 + GO3 + GO4 + GO5 + GO6 + GO7 + S1. NZ1c (carbon in NZ1) and GO2 (backup inside GO1) are 'of which' rows, never added. S1, the same-in-both block, cancels.

value.name: The headline
value.equation: headline = Σ over 2002-24 of gap(y) x CPIH(2024) / CPIH(y); 2025 provisional, never in the sum.

value.name: Per household
value.equation: cost per household(y) = gap(y) in 2024 prices / households(y) (ONS, GB); summed over 2002-24 for the 2002-24 figure. Of which on a household's own bill: the household share of each line plus VAT, CCL excluded.

value.name: VAT, both bills
value.equation: NZ11 = v x (d x (NZ1 + NZ2 + NZ3 + NZ4 + NZ4b + NZ5 + NZ6 + NZ7) + NZ10); GO7 = v x d x (GO1 + GO1k + GO2 + GO3 + GO4 + GO5); v = 5% (domestic rate), d = households' share of supply (DUKES 5.2, 5.5.D). VAT on the extra = NZ11 - GO7.

value.name: Reliable Britain's power (GO1)
value.equation: GO1 = the plant Britain had on its actual output at the actual price less carbon + extra running of that plant for renewables' output at the market price + new plant (fixed, fuel, running, transport) + the merit-order uplift (Shao et al. 2022 coefficients in 2002-20, Jan-Apr 2021 and 2024-25p; re-estimated on outturn with direct coefficients from May 2021 to Dec 2023, decision 0164) + the gas-price feedback; each part by year is in the run file's GO1 note and fleet[y].

value.name: Gas-price feedback
value.equation: dP / P = dQ / ((e_s + e_d) x Q), with dQ the road's extra gas burn and Q the gas market's volume; central e_s + e_d = 0.06 + 0.169; both ways (dQ signed): the price rises in years when the road burns more gas than Britain did and falls in years when it burns less.
value.set_by: spec §15.6; 0033; 0144 item 2A; Albrizio et al. (2022) eq. 5

value.name: Carbon, counted once
value.equation: NZ1c = the carbon part of the wholesale price, inside NZ1 (NZ1c_tax: carbon prices collected as tax on power; NZ1c_price: the rest). GO3 = 0: Reliable Britain pays no carbon price.

value.name: Backup (NZ5)
value.equation: NZ5 = the Capacity Market actually paid less what Reliable Britain's own fleet would have needed, floored at zero under the central rule.

value.name: The 2001 levels
value.equation: NZ2 counted = the line less the Fossil Fuel Levy at its 2001 level (to 2019); NZ10 counted = the line less EESoP at its 2001 level x its electricity share; NZ8 counted = the CCL above its 2001 rate; each netting takes its VAT with it.

value.name: Lost value (§12.6), a labelled estimate
value.equation: r(y) = gap(y) / RB(y) (the whole bill, each line once); quoted (constant elasticity on actual demand): L / gap = (1 + r) / (r (1 + e)) x (1 - (1 + r)^-(1 + e)) - 1; straight line: L / gap = |e| r / 2; e(y) = s(y) x e_households + (1 - s(y)) x e_others.

value.name: Other gas users (§9.8), a labelled estimate
value.equation: 0070 D1: rise = dQ / (e Q) from the engine's feedback; gross = rise x actual gas price x non-power gas volume (DUKES 2026 Table 4.1, demand less electricity generation) x GB share (DESNZ sub-national Table 7.2); net = gross x (1 - UK production / UK demand). Full same-year pass-through assumed.
